subject: Wanting to play?
author: AJ92
body:
Want to try manhunt but don't have anyone to play with?

Xbox 360: search in custom games and look for the gamertag AJ92 hosting a game.

PS3: sorry, but we don't have anyone who hosts manhunt regularly or even playing on PS3 as far as I know.

BUT if you are on PS3 and want to be a regular hoster of manhunt send me a private message and we'll se what we can get set up.

And if you do end up being a hoster but want to stop hosting, don't worry about it, just send me a private message and I'll take you off the list.

 

Remember that anyone is encouraged to host manhunt anytime, but we're trying to find people to host it on a regular basis.

 

I greatly appreciate feed back so if you play manhunt or even think it looks cool, then drop a comment so I know I'm not wasting my time.
